title: Who painted it? Match four famous paintings
subtitle: Match the Mona Lisa, The Starry Night, The Scream and Girl with a Pearl Earring to their painters, and hear how a theft made one world-famous.
notes: Match cards with icons; middle column: 'stolen 1911 / found 1913', an empty frame drawn at the theft, a sketched Mona Lisa put back in it at the return, 'most famous' under it. Cards cannot be enlarged.
